name: Turkey Chili
subtitle: With yogurt crema, cheddar, scallions and lime
before: Turkey moved from the freezer to the fridge **the morning before**.
notes: No cayenne in the pot, so it stays mild; add hot sauce at the table. Bouillon is salty, so salt goes in at the end.

items: Salt to taste at the end
1 cup Greek yogurt + 1 Tbsp lime juice + pinch salt

steps.title: Chop and mix spices
steps.body: Chop **2 onions** and **2 bell peppers**, and mince **6 cloves garlic**, all into one bowl. In a small bowl: **½ cup chili powder + 4 tsp cumin + 2 tsp oregano**.

steps.title: Brown the turkey
steps.body: Pot over **medium-high**, **2 tsp olive oil**. Press in **2 lb turkey** and leave it **4 min** to brown. While it browns, open the **2 cans of tomatoes**, drain and rinse **4 cans beans**, and make **2 cups broth**. Break up the turkey, cook **3–4 min** more, spoon off fat, and move it to a bowl.

steps.title: Aromatics
steps.body: Add the **other 2 tsp olive oil** and the **onions, peppers and garlic**. Cook **6–7 min**, scraping up the browned bits.

steps.title: Bloom the spices
steps.body: Return the turkey. Add the **spice bowl + 3 Tbsp tomato paste** and stir **1–2 min** until it darkens and smells toasty.

steps.title: Fill the pot
steps.body: Add the **tomatoes with liquid + 2 cups broth + beans + 3 cups frozen corn**. Scrape the bottom and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Simmer, and make toppings
steps.body: Simmer **uncovered 40–45 min**, stirring every 10 min. Meanwhile: whisk **1 cup yogurt + 1 Tbsp lime juice + pinch salt**, slice **3 scallions**, and cut the limes into wedges.

steps.title: Season
steps.body: Salt **¼ tsp at a time**, tasting each time (likely ½–1 tsp total). A squeeze of lime if it tastes flat.

steps.title: Serve and portion
steps.body: Serve 2-cup bowls with crema, cheddar, scallions, lime and chips. Pack lunches of 2 cups and freeze the rest in 2-cup containers.

after: Cool leftovers in shallow containers; a full pot stays warm for hours.

source.label: Ambitious Kitchen, Seriously the Best Healthy Turkey Chili

macros.basis: per 2-cup bowl with crema and cheddar
macros.portion: A 2-cup bowl of chili with about 2 Tbsp yogurt crema and 1 oz cheddar. Chips not included.
